text:
Claire T: heads-up 1: leadership wants SKU consolidation: reduce 8 legacy SKUs to 3 throughput tiers + add-on matrix. goal is simpler sales ops and clearer entitlements. need product checklist for migration and launch criteria.

Ben S: big win for GTM but migration is thorny. primary asks: grandfather pricing, migration credits, and a clear opt-in window. also need to quantify revenue risk from customers who currently pay more under legacy SKUs.

Yusuf N: engineering: unified SKU doable but requires billing mapping layer and per-customer flags for 3 months. we need to support dual-billing during transition and an idempotent migration job. estimate 3 sprints to build.

Maya R: docs + AE enablement: must produce a migration playbook, entitlements comparison table, and FAQ explaining "why you're paying more/less". also a scripted email template for AEs to use.

Legal-Bot: auto: legal constraints: existing contracts with explicit SKU references need amendment. recommend template amendment and a 30-day notice minimum for commercial customers. no unilateral price increases.

Ben S: pricing ops: propose migration credit equal to 50% of monthly delta for 2 months for customers who would pay more under new tiers. Also propose a grandfather cohort for major-enterprise for 12 months with optional opt-in.

Claire T: risk register note: customers on custom overage clauses, reserved commitments, or reseller contracts need special handling. flagging enterprise CSMs to manually approve migrations.

Yusuf N: ops items: feature-flag "sku_consolidation_v1" in staging; need per-tenant rollout, rollback, and metrics to detect revenue delta. also require a dry-run migration mode that outputs proposed new invoice line items.

ops-bot: created feature-flag sku_consolidation_v1 in staging. owner=product. added dashboard tile: "migration-dry-run-preview".

Maya R: UX note: billing page must show both legacy and new tier views during transition. also add a tooltip that shows "estimated change" and migration credit status. I'll draft wireframes.

Ben S: launch-pricing proposal: three tiers (Starter, Scale, Enterprise) with clear throughput bands and add-ons: priority-routing, dedicated-pool, on-prem connector. add-on pricing unchanged but re-usable across tiers.

Claire T: go/no-go checklist (first pass):
1) mapping doc of legacy SKUs -> new tiers (Ben)
2) migration-credit rules + finance sign-off (Ben + billing)
3) legal amendment template (Legal-Bot)
4) feature-flag + dry-run tool (Yusuf + ops)
5) docs + AE playbook + email templates (Maya)
6) launch metrics & rollback plan (ops)

billing-bot: note: to support dry-run we need an API that returns projected invoice lines. creating ticket BILL-5023 and tagging engineering-billing.

Ben S: I'll circulate mapping and revenue sensitivity model by EOD. need a list of customers on custom SKUs from CSMs.

Legal-Bot: will produce amendment template and a short checklist for contracts that require legal review. ETA 48h.

Yusuf N: dev plan: sprint 1 build dry-run tool + flag, sprint 2 support migration job + billing API, sprint 3 rollout automation + monitoring. need 2 engineers full-time to hit 6-week target.

Maya R: i'll start the migration playbook draft and wireframes. will post links here when ready.

Claire T: timeline proposal: 6-week internal rollout, 4-week opt-in for customers, then auto-migration for non-responders. all dependent on go/no-go signoff. scheduling a 30m decision on Friday.

Ben S: small ask: include a cadence for AE compensation adjustment if new tiers reduce expected ARR. we should involve sales ops.

Claire T: noted. adding Sales Ops to the decision invite. thanks all. Please drop short updates in this thread. :rocket:
